title: A Heterogeneous FitzHugh-Nagumo Model Exhibiting Local and Regional Dynamics that Mimic Spontaneous Atrial Fibrillation
summary: We study two-dimensional networks of FitzHugh-Nagumo oscillators in regimes that mimic cardiac tissue. The networks include small layers of cells that have fast-recovery characteristics and adjacent layers of cells that have slow-recovery. Numerical simulations show that the boundary between the fast- and slow-recovery cells can initiate fibrillatory-like behavior when activated by a single, healthy wave in the network.
